  "population_and_setting": "University students in the eastern coastal region of the People’s Republic of China.",
  "sample_size_total": 539,
  "recruitment_and_incentive": "Recruited after classes; no compensation provided.",
  "analysis_plan": "Partial correlations between moral perfectionism dimensions (PMS and CMM) and moral outcomes, controlling for the overlap between PMS and CMM.",
  "preregistered_or_confirmatory": "not stated",
  "other_methods_notes": "The study used three separate samples (N=168, N=206, N=165) to measure different moral outcomes. The focal effect concerns the partial correlation between CMM and forgiveness judgments after controlling for PMS."
